links.outcome: Accuracy of general multimodal LLMs for bone lesion detection and characterization on radiographs
links.effect: Detection accuracy 0.803 for ChatGPT 5.2, 0.677 for MedGemma 4B; Claude and Gemini sensitivity 0.991/0.972 but specificity 0.038/0.201; DeepSeek-VL2 malignancy sensitivity 0.022.
links.quote: These findings suggest that, despite their potential, current multimodal LLMs are not yet sufficiently reliable for diagnostic use in orthopedic oncology and should be considered investigational until further development and validation.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic performance of several multimodal foundation models on retrospective radiograph datasets without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
